ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/beige) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible ventral area compared to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central high-intensity region spanning both lobes; thick low-intensity black border along leading edges and lateral tips; right lobe distal region contains scattered low-intensity pixel clusters and splotches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, small-amplitude irregular peaks; right lobe distal edge features a series of three distinct small notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a broad convex arc; trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated on the black peripheral margins of both fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible thin, dark linear disruptions on the white ventral surface of the right lobe, oriented primarily vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor trailing edge irregularities and small notches present, particularly on the outer third of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown pixel tinting (bio-fouling) covering approximately 60% of the central high-intensity surface area.
